title: Trail Food Planner Printable, Backpacking Meal Planner, Day Hike Snack List, Hiking Food Checklist, Camping Food Weight Worksheet PDF
description:
Never sure how much food to bring on a hike? This 20-page planner takes you from a long day hike to a 3 to 5 day backpacking trip: how much to pack, what to eat and when, and fill-in planners that turn it into a packed bag.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- Why food planning matters: energy, pack weight, trash and wildlife, plus the classic beginner mistakes
- How much food to bring: common planning ranges for day hikes and overnights, what changes how much you need, and how to find your own number
- Day hike snack rhythm with a sample 5-hour hike, and what travels well on hot and cold days
- No-cook trail food ideas and boil-only breakfast and dinner ideas
- Stove or no stove: a plain comparison and fuel planning basics
- Food storage: bear canisters, hangs and lockers
- Food in hot and cold weather
- Fill-in pages: day hike food planner, overnight meal planner, 3 to 5 day meal planner, food weight worksheet in lb and kg, shopping list, repack and label checklist, group food plan with allergies and diet needs, and after-trip notes

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Imperial and metric throughout (lb and kg, oz and g). Not diet or medical advice: the numbers are common planning ranges, so ask your doctor or a registered dietitian if you follow a medical diet. Food storage rules differ by park, so check the official rules for your trip. Print the fill-in pages again for every trip. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
